About.heroSubtitle: PT. Limars Teknik Indonesia builds custom traditional ovens and commercial kitchen systems for restaurants across Indonesia.
About.visionDesc: To be a trusted traditional oven builder and kitchen contractor recognized for reliable build quality, safety, and durability.

missionList.1: Build high-temperature traditional ovens (Wood-Fired Pizza, Mandi, Tannur, Kamado) that withstand heat over 500°C.
missionList.2: Provide complete restaurant kitchen contracting, from certified gas piping and exhaust ducting to SS304 stainless steel fabrication.
missionList.3: Develop fuel-efficient wood-fired ovens and commercial stoves to support food businesses.
missionList.4: Deliver hands-on technical support and ongoing maintenance to keep kitchen operations running reliably.

About.journeySubtitle: Milestones and completed kitchen projects since 2014.

2014.title: Inception & First Build
2014.desc: Limars Teknik was founded in Jakarta and built its first Gold Mosaic Wood-Fired Pizza Oven at Zahra Al-Jazeerah Cianjur.

2015.title: Middle Eastern Mandi Ovens
2015.desc: Commissioned by Al-Jazeerah Cikini & Central Pramuka restaurant groups to build custom Lamb Mandi & Arab Bread ovens.

2016.title: 180cm Dome Oven & Puncak Tannur
2016.desc: Built a 180cm diameter dome pizza oven at Al-Jazeerah Polonia and a pit-style Tannur oven at Royal Al-Jazeerah Puncak.

2018.title: Japanese Kamado & Nanamia Pizzeria
2018.desc: Built a Japanese Kamado hearth at Dashi Chazuke Grand Indonesia, an oven at Istanbul Turkey Kemang, and a pizza oven for Nanamia Pizzeria Jogja.

2021.title: Ongoing Restaurant Partnerships
2021.desc: Continued builds with wood-fired pizza ovens for Nanamia Pizzeria Branch 2 (2021) and Branch 3 (2023).

2025.title: Portable Oven Line Development
2025.desc: Developing fuel-efficient portable oven lines for modern eateries and food vendors.

dataProtection.title: Data Protection
dataProtection.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

thirdPartySharing.title: Third-Party Sharing
thirdPartySharing.content: We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share information with trusted service providers who assist us in operating our website or conducting our business, subject to strict confidentiality agreements.
